# WJ5 · Nhân viên · Thêm nhân viên · email đã dùng

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · state · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/users`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
State of [WJ1](WJ1.md) · Nhân viên: Thêm nhân viên · email đã dùng. Page: Staff accounts of the clinic: who can sign in to the dashboard, with which role, and whether the account is locked. Filters by name or email, role and status; add, edit, lock or unlock, reset a password.

## Agent and care context
- A locked account cannot sign in and all its sessions end at once; changing a role also ends the sessions. The owner cannot lock or change the role of their own account (422) and the clinic always keeps at least one active owner (422). Audit records field names, roles and ids, never name, email or password.
- These accounts are the people the care agent hands conversations to: their skills and shifts are edited on the care administration page (WK1).

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.users.read` to see the list (owner, manager); `admin.users` to add, edit, lock or unlock and reset passwords (owner only).
- Roles that can open the page: owner (manages); manager (read only, WJ2); doctor, cs_staff and reception have no menu entry and see the forbidden card of the shell (WL17).
- Menu entry: "Nhân viên" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.users.read`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- "Thêm nhân viên" (owner): create an account with a first password of 8 characters or more
- "Sửa": change name and role (the role of the own account is locked)
- "Đặt lại mật khẩu": owner sets a new password, every session of that person ends
- "Khóa" / "Mở khóa": the exit path, there is no hard delete
- Search by name or email; chip groups "Vai trò" and "Trạng thái"

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Thêm nhân viên
- Bạn thao tác quá nhanh. Hãy đợi một phút rồi thử lại.
- Tài khoản vừa được người khác thay đổi. Danh sách đã được tải lại, hãy thử lại.
- Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.
- Không tìm thấy tài khoản này. Danh sách đã được tải lại.
- Email đăng nhập này đã được dùng trong phòng khám. Hãy chọn email khác.
- Phòng khám phải luôn có ít nhất một chủ phòng khám đang hoạt động.

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
